name: urk
description: Universal Runtime Kernel - public, open-source runtime for interactive browser experiences

scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/player-desktop && corepack yarn workspace @urk/player-desktop start
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/player-desktop && corepack yarn workspace @urk/player-desktop package
scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/adapters @urk/player-desktop && corepack yarn workspace @urk/player-desktop test
scripts.test: corepack yarn test:build && corepack yarn workspace @urk/core test && corepack yarn workspace @urk/adapters test && corepack yarn workspace @urk/cli test && corepack yarn workspace urk-examples test && corepack yarn workspace @urk/next-proof test && corepack yarn workspace @urk/www check
scripts.lint: corepack yarn typecheck && corepack yarn workspace @urk/www check
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/examples @urk/next @urk/cli @urk/player && corepack yarn workspace urk-examples test:browser
scripts.export:demo: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/adapters @urk/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js export examples/picking
scripts.demo:player: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/player @urk/adapters @urk/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js export examples/picking --out-dir ../../.codex/player/picking --overwrite && node scripts/serve-player-demo.mjs
scripts.test:player: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/player @urk/adapters @urk/cli && corepack yarn workspace urk-examples test:browser --config playwright.player.config.ts
scripts.test:portable: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/adapters @urk/cli && corepack yarn workspace urk-examples test:browser --config playwright.player.config.ts portable-workflow.spec.ts
scripts.dev:v02: node scripts/build.mjs @urk/examples @urk/next && corepack yarn workspace urk-examples dev --host 127.0.0.1
